# Bloodborne MacOS 1.0

This release combines the CrossOver launcher with the Supermedo Bloodborne runtime source. The Windows runtime is built from the included source and carries the FSR 3.1 fix for Apple unified memory.

## Assets

- `Bloodborne-MacOS-1.0.dmg`: Apple Silicon launcher.
- `Bloodborne-Windows.zip`: patched runtime used by the launcher through CrossOver.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for the downloadable release files.

Bring your own legally obtained CUSA03173 game files. See the repository README for setup.
